metadata.notes: Mapper catalogue re-authored for US1: service types aligned to feature-001 (VPLS, VPWS/E-Line, L3VPN, IRB). CNC-oriented subjects removed.

VPLS.description: Map a full-mesh Layer-2 bridge (VPLS) between two or more attachments for a tenant.
examples: provision a VPLS between leaf01 ethernet1 and leaf02 ethernet2 for tenant acme
create a multipoint L2 VPLS for tenant acme across site-a xe-0/0/1, site-b xe-0/0/2, site-c xe-0/0/3

VPWS.description: Map a point-to-point Layer-2 service (VPWS / E-Line) between exactly two attachments for a tenant.
examples: provision a point-to-point 1G E-Line between leaf01 ethernet1 and leaf02 ethernet2 for tenant acme
create a VPWS between dc1-leaf1 xe-0/0/4 and dc2-leaf2 xe-0/0/5 for tenant acme vlan 200

L3VPN.description: Map a Layer-3 VPN service between one or more sites for a tenant (VRF-based).
examples: create an L3VPN between paris and london for tenant acme
provision a layer3 vpn for tenant acme at site-a and site-b

IRB.description: Map an integrated L2+L3 (IRB) service: a VPLS bridge domain with a routed VRF and gateways.
examples: provision an IRB between site-a xe-0/0/1 and site-b xe-0/0/2 for tenant acme vlan 10
create IRB service for tenant acme at leaf01 ethernet10
